content: {"parts":[{"id":"P1","status":"answered","claims":[{"text":"For a new text analytics application requiring feature engineering, the system starts by estimating its semantic proximity (from the perspective of a NLP data scientist) with existing applications that have known features.","evidence_ids":["ev_165565719290de88f6c35d49","ev_9cac2d22ef8a0093a3d7b60a"]},{"text":"The new application's fields are represented similar to existing applications in the knowledge base, including text based description, analysis unit, ML challenge classification, and performance measurement details.","evidence_ids":["ev_2762ba4227f0171680cc9c36","ev_998aa085997f713d18b7c0b4","ev_630a7be89b75f8a5cf9c3eda","ev_7a461580e3f2f26315b04733","ev_a645a0d7fa87e12fb8114946"]},{"text":"A degree-1 ego-similarity network is created for the new application to represent how close it is with existing applications, represented as a diagonal matrix where each entry is the proximity between the new application and each existing application in the knowledge base.","evidence_ids":["ev_664da1b9a2acec5828629990"]},{"text":"Proximity between applications is estimated by generating field-level embeddings (using BM25-weighted word embeddings averaged over entity-terms, action-terms, and remaining words), computing field-level cosine similarities, and estimating mean similarity across constituent fields.","evidence_ids":["ev_9a225081564de7fa56e854a9","ev_1d0a2cf71c319c9d4c74c2ba","ev_890ab8bb002d8f3f4cd2b4d4","ev_9cd1fe025f8d9eaf2d51bd45"]},{"text":"Probable relevance of a feature for the new application is computed by multiplying the proximity matrix with the feature co-occurrence (relevance) matrix, measuring probable relevance with respect to the performance metric based upon the feature's relevance for existing applications.","evidence_ids":["ev_a8bc275e8b1a3d479c80c51b","ev_9028a5efc6dacc23fd64d4a3"]},{"text":"Collective relevance for the new application can be estimated using different policies including weakest relevance (minimum), strongest relevance (maximum), or most likely relevance (mean) across applications.","evidence_ids":["ev_acaeb44247e7aecd2039d223","ev_0dd54b2ac8d1e03b674c99df","ev_e87034bea6093be9a8e99565","ev_e31385feff80447142bbb9b5"]},{"text":"Feature specifications are ranked in decreasing order based upon Relevance(NewP, .) and suggested to the NLP Data Scientist together with supporting evidence.","evidence_ids":["ev_f24c248ac254206d82885945"]},{"text":"Based upon proximity estimates and expected relevance of features for existing applications, the system recommends features for the new application in a ranked order, and if user's selections are not aligned with system's recommendations, it gradually adapts its recommendations to achieve alignment with user preferences.","evidence_ids":["ev_165565719290de88f6c35d49"]}],"missing":[]}]}
